summary: "Meetup Mondays" is Archetype Brewing's own weekly branded programming block (Mondays 7-10pm), not a single group of people. It rotates between different activities run by different organizers: a weekly craft night done with the Keep Asheville Crafty group, alternating Brazilian Roda drum/song circles, and a Meetup.com-organized Singles Game Night. The host (the brewery) recurs every week, but the activity and attendee base rotate, matching a venue promotion rather than one returning community.

evidence.note: MountainX listings describe the night as mixing craft nights, Brazilian Roda music, and Singles Game Night in the same taproom slot, i.e. rotating distinct activities under one venue brand, not one group.
Explore Asheville summaries describe it generically as a 'casual Monday evening hangout' for 'meeting new people,' with no membership language, dues, or named regulars.

The full listing confirms Archetype Brewing is the organizer and that the craft component is done in collaboration with the separate Keep Asheville Crafty group, while the singles nights are coordinated via an external Meetup.com group.

Search results surface a distinct Meetup.com group, 'Single and Social in Asheville,' as the actual organizer behind the singles game nights held at Archetype -- a different, already-existing group using the venue's slot, not a standalone 'Meetup Mondays' community.

Separate listings for 'Game Night for Singles at Archetype Brewing' exist independently of the 'Meetup Mondays' branding, reinforcing that the umbrella name is a venue marketing label for varying programming rather than one persistent group's identity.
